source_reconstruction_scope: Bounded TargetList Search path called by CharAI::_UpdateAggro for constructor flags 0x7fffffff, object filter 2, closest sort 1, selected view radius and full-circle cone. The adapter consumes a borrowed room registry and actor-owned virtual services; it does not implement _UpdateAggro's classification, aggro mutation, event routing, or Android actor integration.
file_offset_policy: The pinned original ELF has .text sh_addr == .text sh_offset == 0x30ee00 and .data.rel.ro mapping uses the same address/file-offset relation; the host runner verifies the full library SHA and each recorded range.
caller_facts: CharAI::_UpdateAggro constructs TargetList(owner, 0x7fffffff, 2, 1): all-relationship Character flags, object filter 2, and closest sort 1.
CharAI::_UpdateAggro passes the selected AI row ViewRadius or ViewRadiusNoAggro and a 2π cone to SearchEff; 2π does not impose a directional cutoff.

TargetList filter 2 rejects non-Character GameObjects. TargetList::_IsCharacterValid with flags 0x7fffffff still rejects when owner Character+0x1314 < candidate Character+0x1310, then returns true without the narrower dead/enemy/player/group checks.

Search still applies the candidate visible byte, virtual IsZonable and its source byte +0x2ee/+0x2f0 condition, virtual IsInteractive(candidate, owner), candidate interaction radius, owner CharAI melee radius, range test and closest ordering.

For each accepted Character, TargetInfo flag bit 0 is set. TargetSorter::_sortClosest prioritizes bit 0, then compares adjusted distance strictly; in this filter-2 path all returned candidates have bit 0 set, so _UpdateAggro consumes nearest-first results.

CharAI::_UpdateAggro classifies popped candidates as friend/neutral/enemy and raises source event 7/8/9 in result order. This adapter preserves candidate order but does not implement those relation queries or event dispatch.

The Character vtable address point at 0x965f38 has +0x88 Character::IsInteractive(GameObject*) at 0x3a4870, +0x94 Character::GetInteractionRadius() at 0x3a374c, and +0xc4 Character::IsZonable() at 0x3a36e4. The adapter labels services by these resolved methods, not by guessed slot names.
The host tests model service results and normalized getter snapshots. They are not an original ARM function differential, live actor registry, or Android runtime test.
unsupported: No owner/player enemy gate is added to this TargetList query.
The existing character_target_search kernel is for the separate melee flags-1/filter-0 caller and is not invoked or modified.

Search service failures, pointer validation, bounded heap capacity, and opaque Character/room lifetimes are adapter boundaries. A source service error can occur after earlier candidates have been processed; no rollback is claimed.

The `_UpdateAggro` shared turn/delay/random prefix, highest-aggro branch, friend/neutral/enemy classifier, aggro storage mutation, Character event gates, script callback, and controller pursuit are separate and not implemented here.
Original tie behavior is only covered by the strict source comparator and copied priority-queue heap mechanics; the source does not guarantee a stable identity order for equal distances.
